title: Dirty truth of Bhojpuri Industry
description:
Once rooted in folk culture and tradition, the Bhojpuri film industry today is drowning in cheap content, vulgar lyrics, and over-the-top drama. Instead of promoting regional pride, many Bhojpuri movies and songs now focus on obscenity and mindless violence, giving the industry a bad reputation.

Actors and producers chase quick profits through viral songs rather than investing in quality storytelling or cinema that can stand tall nationally. As a result, genuine talent and meaningful content get sidelined.

In this video, we expose what went wrong with Bhojpuri cinema and why the industry needs a cultural reset.
